TEXT.English: [H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Alien Civilizations:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]The alien races (natives) are now enabled as playable civilizations. They begin with several existing settlements via Advanced Start and maintain an advantage in harvesting native resources, but are much slower than humans at developing advanced infrastructure and manufactured goods.[NEWLINE][H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Alien Economy:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]The alien races have a [COLOR_ALT_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]significant advantage[COLOR_REVERT] in starting with settlements already populated and established. However, living in a state of pastoral anarchy, most alien settlements must rebuild their long-dilapidated [LINK=BUILDING_CARPENTER_SHOP]Construction Facilities[\LINK] to enable further organized development, effectively giving Human players a 50-turn head start. Aliens that adopted a nomadic lifestyle in ages past may also periodically return to the fold, displaced by Human colonizers. Alien civilizations have a disadvantage compared to Humans when it comes to the production of manufactured goods. To procure these manufactured goods, the Aliens of the New Worlds can either directly purchase them from the Third World nations of Earth at great cost or acquire the assistance of Human specialists through abduction, propaganda, or 'generous economic incentives'. The Ziggurat, a warehouse upgrade unique to the aliens, functions as a local market building representing the aliens' internal economy, enabling each settlement to automatically sell excess resources at a small fraction of the price on Earth. This ratio can be increased by constructing buildings such as the [LINK=BUILDING_ALIEN_SHIPYARD]Alien Shipyard[\LINK] to enable offworld trade with independent smugglers; however, the true profits will come from eventually gaining direct access to the distant markets of Earth.[NEWLINE][H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Aliens and Earth:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]Shocked by the arrival of the newcomers from Earth, many of the alien societies of the New Worlds have reactivated ancient [LINK=UNIT_SAUCER]Saucers[\LINK] to travel between the stars on their own terms. Eventually, with the restoration of their infrastructure, they will be able to rebuild their fleets. (Note that [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Alien spaceships[COLOR_REVERT] use a different propulsion mechanism than the Terran vessels, which are restricted to Deep Space and Low Orbit tiles. [COLOR_MAGENTA]By right-clicking over a planet's interior, an Alien vessel can fly through the entirety of its atmosphere[COLOR_REVERT], reaching colonies not directly accessible to Terran ships.) Due to the monopolistic practices of the Earth superpowers, aliens can only conduct covert trade with disenfranchised Third World nations, and the market prices they receive will be much less favorable than those of human colonies. Nevertheless, smuggling goods to the black markets of Earth can prove a vital lifeline for alien civilizations.[NEWLINE][H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Aliens and Human Colonists:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]The political situation in some Earthling nations has become so intolerable that some truly desperate aliens are able to abduct a steady trickle of human colonists to their worlds by building an [LINK=BUILDING_HABITAT]Earthling Habitat[\LINK] in their cities to generate Propaganda. Although aliens again have a [COLOR_WARNING_TEXT]severe disadvantage[COLOR_REVERT] in attracting emigrants compared to the human colonies, the manufacturing skills of even unspecialized human colonists make them greatly prized among the species of the New Worlds. Abducting human colonists by force is another alternative to gain access to their skills; upon conquering a human colony, aliens can obtain enough Earthling tissue to create a [LINK=UNIT_HUMANHYBRID]Human Hybrid[\LINK] who will also work in manufacturing facilities much more efficiently than the aliens themselves.[NEWLINE][H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Aliens and Liberty:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]Previously accustomed to unquestioning obedience to the tyranny of the long-absent Progenitors, the arrival of the Earthlings stimulated many alien elders to return to the ways of their ancient mystery traditions in search of enlightenment and power. Long dismissed as the rantings of conspiracy theorists, secret societies such as the Illuminati have covertly permeated alien and human societies for centuries, and have many secret adherents among certain select members of the Earth elite. Through deep connections to this far-reaching conspiracy, the alien [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Elders[COLOR_REVERT] of an [LINK=BUILDING_ILLUMINATI_LODGE]Illuminati Lodge[\LINK] could begin to challenge the dominance of the Progenitors among their race, and even attract highly placed human Directors to conspire with their agenda.[NEWLINE][H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Alien Specialists:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]With sufficient resources, aliens may eventually [COLOR_ALT_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]train[COLOR_REVERT] elite members of their species that are much more versatile than the narrowly focused human specialists, though slightly less effective in each individual field. The [LINK=UNIT_CYBORG]Industrious Cyborg[\LINK] produces Hammers, Tools, and Weapons nearly as efficiently as human specialists, the [LINK=UNIT_POLYMATH]Brilliant Polymath[\LINK] can approach the abilities of a human Physicist, Biochemist, Drug Runner, and Theorist all in one, and the [LINK=UNIT_ELDER]Venerable Elder[\LINK] can generate Liberty by working in an [LINK=BUILDING_ELDER_COUNCIL]Elder Council[\LINK] or [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MENHIR]Menhir[\LINK], as well as planning the abduction of human servants from Earth through work in an [LINK=BUILDING_HABITAT]Earthling Habitat[\LINK] or [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ALTAR]Abduction Site.[\LINK][NEWLINE][H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Alien Improvements:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]A number of secret alien sites are scattered across the New Worlds, though many are quickly ransacked for treasure by the Earthling imperialists. If these sites can be captured and protected, an alien working as a [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Ritualist[COLOR_REVERT] on a tile containing a sacred [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MENHIR]Menhir[\LINK] can be a powerful force for Liberty, or an [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Abductor[COLOR_REVERT] working at an [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ALTAR]Abduction Site[\LINK] can engineer the abduction of human servitors from Earth. With the labor of human specialists or through direct purchase from Earth, aliens that acquire enough Biotech can train a [LINK=UNIT_CULTIVATOR]Cultivator[\LINK] [COLOR_MAGENTA]capable of[COLOR_REVERT] building [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ALIEN_FERTILIZERS]Alien Fertilizer[\LINK] and [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ALIEN_BURROW]Alien Burrow[\LINK] improvements, which, given time as the tile [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]is worked[COLOR_REVERT] by its parent city, will develop into rich [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ALIEN_FUTUREFARM]Plantation biospheres[\LINK] and [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_ALIEN_CAVERN]Cavern complexes[\LINK] that create significant wealth.

[H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Technologies:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]There is a new "Research" icon (light bulb) at the top of the screen. Click on this to bring up the Research Advisor. The Research Screen is similar to the Civ4 Tech screen. You can scroll up or down to view all the techs. Mouse over any tech to see what it has to offer. Techs currently available for research will say "Click to Research". The current tech you are researching will be highlighted, and the number of turns to complete will appear at the bottom of the screen. Completed research is labeled with a darkened background.[NEWLINE]To start learning new techs, assign one of your [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]colonists[COLOR_REVERT] to the [LINK=BUILDING_INVENTORS_HOUSE]Research Lab[\LINK] in your city screen (or one of its upgrades, the [LINK=BUILDING_INVENTORS_WORKSHOP]Research Institute[\LINK] or [LINK=BUILDING_INVENTORS_LABORATORY]Research Complex[\LINK], or the [LINK=BUILDING_SHAMAN]Shamanic Lodge[\LINK] if playing an alien race). Production of each unit of [LINK=YIELD_IDEAS]Research[\LINK] (bulbs) consumes one unit of one or more different resources, depending on the tech. Some of the more advanced technologies may also require that a [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]specific colonist[COLOR_REVERT] type be assigned to the project.[NEWLINE]In the City Screen, you can mouse over the "Research" lightbulb icon to see the current project, resources consumed, current progress, and turns to complete. You can also change projects here by clicking on the Research icon.[NEWLINE][H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]New Unit - Visionary Researcher:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]This scientific mastermind doubles the output of Research. Each unit of research produced in your colonies adds to a meter that [COLOR_MAGENTA]stimulates[COLOR_REVERT] the emigration of a [LINK=UNIT_INVENTOR]Visionary Researcher[\LINK] from Earth.[NEWLINE][H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Tech Trading and Research Pacts:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]The AI players will also pursue their own Research Projects. You can [COLOR_ALT_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]trade[COLOR_REVERT] techs and form Research Pacts to make more rapid progress, or hoard your technology for a strategic edge. Other players will occasionally ask to make tech trades with you. Alien races start with foreknowledge of several special Xenoscience techs, but find mastery of advanced Human technology difficult.[NEWLINE][H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Research Strategy:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]You will begin with access to a [COLOR_WARNING_TEXT]limited[COLOR_REVERT] number of colonists, professions, and resource types and will need to unlock access to these gradually with the progress of research. Researching appropriate technologies can also unlock the benefits of bonus resources distributed across the map, such as the Iridescent Pyramids and Obsidian Faces. Development can be much more challenging than in the unmodified game, but the rewards of mastering advanced technology can be great. At higher difficulty levels, strategic use of technological progress may be essential to winning Independence.

[H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Sites and Expeditions:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]A variety of rare and mysterious sites, such as [LINK=BONUS_TEMPLE]Ruined Temples[\LINK] and [LINK=BONUS_PYRAMID]Iridescent Pyramids[\LINK], can be found dotted throughout the ruins and forests of the New Worlds. See Bonus Resources in the Civilopedia for a complete list and descriptions. After obtaining control of one of these sites, an [LINK=UNIT_SCOUT]Intrepid Explorer[\LINK] assigned to the [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Laborer[COLOR_REVERT] profession can be moved to the tile and ordered to [COLOR_MAGENTA]begin an[COLOR_REVERT] [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_EXPEDITION]Expedition[\LINK] there. This [COLOR_WARNING_TEXT]consumes the unit[COLOR_REVERT], but can greatly increase the amount and variety of resources that can be harvested from the site, particularly after discovering later technologies that boost the yield of Expeditions.

[H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Alien Flora and Fauna:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]The New Worlds are home to a wide variety of unusual plant and animal species, many of which require the discovery of advanced technologies to benefit fully from their potential uses. Several species are endemic to only one of the New Worlds planets, which may require establishing colonial outposts on multiple worlds if you want to benefit from all of their unique advantages. After discovering [LINK=03_1_Interstellar_Ecology]Interplanetary Ecology[\LINK], your [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Laborers[COLOR_REVERT] can build a [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_PASTURE]Pasture[\LINK] on tiles with native animals to gain extra yields from their domestication.

[H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Alien UFOs:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]Even while presenting a facade of benign altruism to the Earthling interlopers, hidden saucers under the control of less sympathetic Alien Elders rained devastation upon unwary human colonists who were rash enough to venture into the New Worlds unprotected. The nimble human Corvettes rapidly grew adept in Evasive Maneuvers, hiding in Low Orbit and strategic Asteroid Belts where they could often outmaneuver more powerful craft, and building colonial networks of Spaceports and Drydocks for damaged vessels to find refuge and repair.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE][COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Alien spaceships[COLOR_REVERT] use a mysterious propulsion mechanism, different from the massive Resonance Drives used by Earthling vessels. While Resonance Drives enable humans to traverse the wormhole more rapidly, they restrict them to Deep Space and Low Orbit tiles. [COLOR_MAGENTA]By right-clicking over a planet's interior, an Alien vessel can fly through the entirety of its atmosphere[COLOR_REVERT], reaching sites and colonies not directly accessible to Earthling ships. This leaves unwary Earthlings vulnerable to abduction by their alien neighbors.

[H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]The Progenitors:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]The New Worlds are littered with the ruins of an ancient civilization called the Progenitors, who appear to have been masters of powerful and nearly incomprehensible technology. Many of the richest sites lie frozen under sheets of ice in uninhabitable polar regions. These arctic climates have preserved many remnants remarkably well, and it is also believed that the Progenitors favored freezing temperatures as their nervous systems had certain semiconductor properties. Although the Progenitors have long been absent, the native alien races of the New Worlds remain under their tyranny, forced to pay ever-escalating tithes. But perhaps the unexpected arrival of the Earthlings and their strange sciences will provide a catalyst for the aliens to shake off their masters' chains?[NEWLINE][H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Progenitor Artifacts:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]Though their inner workings remain far beyond current human understanding, [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Progenitor Artifacts[COLOR_REVERT] are in utmost demand among the scientists and governments of Earth. After discovering the necessary technologies, colonists working as [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Theorists[COLOR_REVERT] in buildings such as the [LINK=BUILDING_FUR_TRADERS_HOUSE]Progenitor Research Lab[\LINK] can process raw Artifacts into even more valuable [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Progenitor Tech[COLOR_REVERT].[NEWLINE][H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Progenitor Ruins:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]Looming among the ruins are several rings of titanic monoliths indicating the site of an abandoned Progenitor Metropolis. These sites are particularly rich in all manner of goods and technologies, but they are often guarded by lethal Progenitor Killbots or entombed in Ancient Mounds that only a [LINK=UNIT_PIONEER]Hardy Laborer[\LINK] can excavate. After successfully capturing a [LINK=BONUS_METROPOLIS]Metropolis[\LINK] and discovering the technology necessary for advanced professions such as the Quantum Physicist and Symbologist, your colonists can access unusually powerful buildings such as a [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_REACTOR]Progenitor Reactor[\LINK] or [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_LIBRARY]Ancient Databank[\LINK], directly producing advanced goods such as [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Fusion Cores[COLOR_REVERT] and [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Research[COLOR_REVERT] [COLOR_MAGENTA]without the need[COLOR_REVERT] for time-consuming manufacture and processing from raw goods inside colonial buildings.

[H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Moons and Lunar Colonies:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]Some planets among the New Worlds are orbited by a variety of small moons, each having a unique ecosystem and composition. Thought to be the remnants of Progenitor experiments in terraforming, these planetoids' unusually dense cores enable them to maintain some semblance of an atmosphere. On moons in orbit close to an existing planetary settlement, a [LINK=UNIT_COLONYSHIP]Colony Ship[\LINK] can found a [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MOON_COLONY1]Lunar Outpost[\LINK], which [COLOR_WARNING_TEXT]consumes the Colony Ship[COLOR_REVERT] and, over time, can develop into a prosperous [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MOON_COLONY2]Lunar Settlement[\LINK] and later a [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_MOON_COLONY3]Lunar Colony[\LINK] as the tile [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]is worked[COLOR_REVERT] by its parent city. Although colonizing the tiny planetoids orbiting the New Worlds requires a huge upfront investment in time and supplies, a mature Lunar Colony can eventually yield useful resources for export to its parent settlement on the planet below.[NEWLINE][H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Atmospheres and Terraforming:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]With the appropriate technology, the delicate instruments carried by a [LINK=UNIT_SCIENCEVESSEL]Science Vessel[\LINK] can permit successful [COLOR_MAGENTA]terraforming[COLOR_REVERT] of the noxious atmospheres common to the New Worlds' resource-rich moons, further enhancing the yield of a resident Lunar Colony.

[H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Asteroid Mining and Anomalies:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]The robotic armatures of a [LINK=UNIT_MININGVESSEL]Mining Vessel[\LINK] can [COLOR_MAGENTA]extract[COLOR_REVERT] valuable resources from the various asteroid belts and space debris scattered across the Deep Space surrounding the New Worlds, depositing them in your nearest city. Additionally, the advanced but delicate research instruments carried by a [LINK=UNIT_SCIENCEVESSEL]Science Vessel[\LINK] can [COLOR_MAGENTA]harvest[COLOR_REVERT] valuable research data and scientific goods from the strange Deep Space anomalies prevalent in close proximity to the wormhole.

[H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Excavations:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1]Buried deep beneath the [COLOR_MAGENTA]Ancient Mounds[COLOR_REVERT] scattered across the New Worlds lie marvelous relics of Progenitor technology. These relics can be recovered by a [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Laborer[COLOR_REVERT] building an [LINK=IMPROVEMENT_EXCAVATION]excavation[\LINK] site on these Ancient Mounds. Once recovered, these relics (Improvements) can grant powerful boons to your industry, military, or even research.

[H1][COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Hydrocarbons:[COLOR_REVERT][\H1][COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Hydrocarbons[COLOR_REVERT] are required to construct specific Earth units, such as [LINK=UNIT_WAGON_TRAIN]Convoys[\LINK], and to unlock essential structures like the [LINK=BUILDING_POWER_PLANT]Power Plant[\LINK] or [LINK=BUILDING_OIL_REFINERY]Oil Refinery[\LINK]. Additionally, they can be sold back on Earth for a profit. Since Alien Civilizations [COLOR_WARNING_TEXT]cannot[COLOR_REVERT] extract hydrocarbons themselves, purchasing this resource is vital for them throughout most of the game.
A centralized Power Plant helps your colony generate added Industry (hammers) from burning Hydrocarbons.

The history of the steam engine stretches back as far as the first century AD, with the first recorded rudimentary steam engine being the aeolipile described by Hero of Alexandria. In the following centuries, the few engines known about were essentially experimental devices used by inventors to demonstrate the properties of steam. In 1543 Blasco de Garay used a primitive steam machine to move a ship in the port of Barcelona. A rudimentary steam turbine device was described by Taqi al-Din in 1551 and Giovanni Branca in 1629.[NEWLINE][TAB]Following Denis Papin's invention of the steam digester in 1679 and the first piston steam engine in 1690, the first practical steam-powered 'engine' was a water pump, developed in 1698 by Thomas Savery. It proved to have only a limited lift height and was prone to boiler explosions, but it still saw some use in mines and pumping stations. The first commercially successful engine did not appear until 1712.[NEWLINE][TAB]Incorporating technologies discovered by Savery and Denis Papin, the atmospheric engine, invented by Thomas Newcomen, paved the way for the Industrial Revolution. Newcomen's engine was relatively inefficient, and in most cases was only used for pumping water. It worked by using the vacuum from condensing steam in a cylinder and was mainly employed for draining mine workings at depths hitherto impossible, but also for providing a reusable water supply for driving waterwheels at factories sited away from a suitable 'head'.[NEWLINE][TAB]The next major step occurred when James Watt developed an improved version of Newcomen's engine, with a separate condenser. Watt's engine used 75% less coal than Newcomen's and was therefore much cheaper to run. Watt proceeded to develop his engine further, modifying it to provide a rotary motion suitable for driving factory machinery. This enabled factories to be sited away from rivers and further accelerated the pace of the Industrial Revolution.

Often acting as havens for free-thinking Researchers working in self-imposed exile from the repressive Earth governments, each human colony contains a small Research Lab equipped for the rudiments of pure scientific inquiry in a variety of fields.
[TAB]A Datacore houses expensive supercomputers and other instruments enabling local Researchers to advance light-years beyond the competition.

As the human presence in the New Worlds expands, so too does the interest of the scientific community. Once the research needs of scientists studying the New Worlds exceed the capacity of the rudimentary science labs brought from Earth, local colonial governments can build expanded facilities and formally recognize a Research Institute in their cities.

Suffocated by the overbearing control and oppressive oversight of universities and other institutions that comprise Terran academe, many of Earth's best and brightest minds have traveled to the New Worlds to pursue their intellectual interests with a level of freedom that has been absent on Earth for decades.[NEWLINE]In support of these endeavors, the colonial governments of the New Worlds can construct Research Complexes. These centers of scientific research rival even the most prestigious academic institutions found on Earth in terms of scientific output and are operated with minimal oversight from Earth governments. This limited oversight makes them a natural gathering place for those who would advocate for independence from Earth.
Strewn with a bewildering assortment of Progenitor artifacts and native fungi, the shamanic lodges of the aliens are centers for scientific learning blended with traditional ritual.

At the center of each alien settlement sits a structure of weathered stone, in a style strangely reminiscent of early Earth civilizations. Representing the first efforts at cohesion among the scattered and disorganized alien races, the Ziggurat serves as a forum for internal barter of various goods and provides a focus for coordinated efforts at further construction. Dismissed by anthropologists as largely of ceremonial importance, the natives will nonetheless defend these structures to the death.

The natives of the New Worlds traveled through space in ancient times and had the infrastructure required to build the ships in which they traveled. These alien shipyards, inspired by the remnants of Progenitor technology, have all fallen into an irreparable state of disrepair.[NEWLINE]The arrival of humans in the New Worlds has inspired the aliens to attempt to rediscover the means by which their ancient shipyards may be reconstructed. Should they successfully do so, they will have the ability to build some of the most powerful fleets the galaxy has ever seen.

Although unfamiliar with the heavy industry of Otherworldly Planets, careful adaptation of Biotech enabled many Human species to develop larger and more efficient versions of arsenals.[NEWLINE]A Midgar is not only one of the most efficient and productive weapons and vehicle manufacturing facilities produced by the human race, but also a valuable financial resource, with automated extraction of precious metals from the crust of the New Worlds. The formidable nature of a Midgar makes it a powerful pull factor for those on Earth considering emigration to the New Worlds and also boosts the confidence of New World colonies contemplating independence.
Although too slow to prove of use during a head-on assault, the threat posed by a Mass Driver's lethal salvos is enough to significantly disrupt an attempt at bombardment from afar.

Although constructing a Space Elevator was a massive undertaking, these structures of plasteel and nanofibers could prove a vital lifeline for colonies far from the orbital paths accessible by Resonance Drive starships.

One alternative to power generation utilizing coal or petroleum fuels is the hydroelectric power plant. This facility utilizes the energy of rapidly moving water to turn the turbines of its generators and produce electricity. In locations where a source of moving water is available, hydro plants offer a clean, safe alternative to coal, petroleum, and nuclear power generation. Hydro plants have their own set of environmental dangers, however. The disruption of a river's normal flow and the massive flooding of the land behind the facility's dam can destroy the habitat of the alien wildlife inhabiting the river basin.

Although unfamiliar with the heavy industry of Earth, careful adaptation of Progenitor technology enabled many alien species to develop larger and more efficient versions of Earthling factories.[NEWLINE]These facilities are capable of extracting fossil fuels and precious metals from the crust of the New Worlds autonomously. In addition to their construction capabilities, Progenitor Autofabs can also bolster the production of manufactured goods in the settlements where they are located, making them highly desirable to the manufacturing-impaired aliens of the New Worlds.

Long accustomed to living in unquestioning obedience to their distant Progenitor overlords, the arrival of the humans stimulated many alien elders to begin to develop an autonomous government for their race.

After investing 100 units of Hard Currency to build an Interstellar Bank, colonists can work as an Offworld Banker to generate a return on investment in the form of additional Hard Currency profits. However, too large an increase in the supply of previously scarce Hard Currency can be self-defeating; with growing imports from offworld, metals prices may decline rapidly on Earth as the underlying economic weakness asserts itself.

Though long dismissed as the rantings of conspiracy theorists, many believe that the aliens of the New Worlds have clandestine contacts with certain secret societies on Earth, making deep inroads among highly placed members of the corporate, governmental and scientific elite. Reawakening the ancient teachings of the Illuminati through the ritual use of refined Narcotics to achieve transcendental enlightenment, some among the aliens began in secret to challenge and undermine the tyranny of their Progenitor masters.

Desperate for the mysterious knowledge of the Earthlings, some alien species would erect a so-called Human Quarter in their settlements modeled after their idea of life on Earth. Although life in these offworld ghettos was seldom as idyllic as planned, they did attract a steady trickle of Earth emigrants, from fringe UFO cultists to those so ruthlessly oppressed that no human colony would accept them.

A [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Power Plant[COLOR_REVERT] can greatly increase a colony's industrial (Hammers) output and also serve as an alternative when Plasteel is scarce. The upgraded [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Oil Refinery[COLOR_REVERT] not only generates certain [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]resources[COLOR_REVERT] on its own, but a [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Refinery Worker[COLOR_REVERT] burning [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Hydrocarbons[COLOR_REVERT] in the Oil Refinery also provides a significant bonus to the production of [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]advanced goods[COLOR_REVERT] in that colony.

The [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Oil Refinery[COLOR_REVERT] replaces the [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Power Plant[COLOR_REVERT] as an industrial support structure. It offers improved efficiency and helps to revolutionize manufacturing throughout the colony. For every 3 [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Hydrocarbons[COLOR_REVERT] consumed, the Refinery generates 1 extra Manufactured good, such as [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Fusion Cores[COLOR_REVERT], [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Biotech[COLOR_REVERT], or [COLOR_HIGHLIGHT_TEXT]Narcotics[COLOR_REVERT]. Oil-powered industrial equipment also significantly aids mining operations, granting a bonus to [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Ore[COLOR_REVERT] and [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Platinum[COLOR_REVERT] extraction.

A [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Research Lab[COLOR_REVERT] is where inventors work; here, they can change the course of history. The resources consumed by [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]inventors[COLOR_REVERT] working in a Research Lab will vary depending on the technology being researched.
The [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Datacore[COLOR_REVERT] increases a colony's research substantially. It is required to build a [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Research Lab[COLOR_REVERT].

An upgrade over the basic [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Research Lab[COLOR_REVERT], a [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Research Institute[COLOR_REVERT] allows a third colonist to work as an inventor. [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Inventors[COLOR_REVERT] working in a Research Institute produce twice as many ideas as those working in a Research Lab, while also consuming twice as many resources.[NEWLINE]The resources consumed depend on the technology being researched.

The final research building constructible by the New World colonies, a [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Research Complex[COLOR_REVERT], boosts the production of both Ideas and Liberty Bells by 25%.[NEWLINE]The resources consumed by colonists working in a Research Complex are determined by the technology being researched.

A [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Shamanic Lodge[COLOR_REVERT] is where alien inventors work; here, they can change the course of history. A Shamanic Lodge allows a fourth alien to work as an [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]inventor[COLOR_REVERT] and also boosts the production of both Ideas and Liberty Bells by 25%. [NEWLINE] The resources consumed by aliens working in a Shamanic Lodge are determined by the technology being researched.
Alone for centuries, our people have grown disorganized and weak. We must build a [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Ziggurat[COLOR_REVERT] to focus the spirit of our race against the Earthling threat.
An [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Alien Shipyard[COLOR_REVERT] is required to construct the most powerful vessels available to the aliens of the New Worlds.
Construct [COLOR_MAGENTA]Midgar[COLOR_REVERT] to let our species labor to produce great wonders.
The threat posed by a [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Mass Driver[COLOR_REVERT] helps keep heavy orbital and ground artillery from mounting a full-scale bombardment.

For colonies far from the trade lanes accessible by major starships, constructing a [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Space Elevator[COLOR_REVERT] will allow transport and sale of excess goods directly through an orbital waystation.

A [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Hydroelectric Plant[COLOR_REVERT] built in a New World colony adjacent to a river will both increase the productive capacity of that colony and the yield of certain resources on the tiles adjacent to that river.
Construct a [COLOR_MAGENTA]Progenitor Autofab[COLOR_REVERT] to let our species labor to produce great wonders.

Build an [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Elder Council[COLOR_REVERT] to begin guiding our people toward independence from the tyranny of the absent Progenitors. With time, our wise Elders may even establish diplomatic contacts with certain highly placed leaders in Earthling society. An Elder Council allows a fourth alien to work as a [COLOR_UNIT_TEXT]Politician[COLOR_REVERT].

After investing 100 units of Hard Currency to build an [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Interstellar Bank[COLOR_REVERT], local colonists can work as an Offworld Banker in Low Orbit tiles to generate a return on investment in the form of additional Hard Currency profits.

The eldest among our people had deep and secret contacts among the Earth elites. Return to the ancient ways and let our people become [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Illuminated[COLOR_REVERT]; we may yet persuade some among the Earthling Illuminati to conspire to advance our agenda.
Construct an [COLOR_BUILDING_TEXT]Earthling Habitat[COLOR_REVERT] to lure outcast thinskins to live among your race.

In the chaos surrounding the near-collapse of the petrochemical industry, much of the Islamic world has fallen under the sway of the Restored Caliphate, ruled by an extensive cabal of reactionary Muslim clerics. Encompassing vast areas from North Africa and the Middle East to fragments of the Indonesian archipelago, the largely Shiite theocracy clings to power with the aid of a brutally repressive inquisition, embroiled in a constant struggle to maintain control over restive Sunni and nationalist movements in its diverse population.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Caliphate soldiers are motivated by a fanatical desire to spread the word of the Prophet across both Earth and space. Maintaining a near-monopoly over Earth's shrinking oil market in the face of a continuing transition to fusion energy, all Caliphate colonies start with a functioning Power Plant.

In a bid to shield themselves from increasing taxation and regulation at the hands of the rapidly expanding Earth governments, many of the largest megacorporations of Earth have fused into a nebulous quasi-national entity known as the Consortium. After targeted economic pressure and the judicious use of mercenaries forced the creation of so-called "enterprise zones" within the decaying superpowers, the Consortium now exerts de facto control over a variety of financial megacenters including Hong Kong, Manhattan, Singapore, Sao Paulo, Zurich, and Dubai, as well as a diversified portfolio of Third World puppet governments.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]The vast and flexible markets of the Enterprise Zones surpass even those of Russia, though Consortium management sees its colonies as nothing more than a profit center, and exacts a heavy tax in the form of constant dividends. With sophisticated distribution centers capable of sourcing a variety of goods, each Consortium colony starts with a free Warehouse.

The Cyeans are known throughout the various species of the New Worlds for their commitment to scholarship and aversion to initiating violence. Cyean scholars possess pictographic records dating back to shortly after the departure of the Progenitors, as well as faint memories, passed on genealogically, from shortly before. With an average height of 9 feet (2.75 meters), the Cyeans can be physically imposing but seldom choose to use this to their advantage. Their preference for diplomatic over military solutions to conflict should not be confused with pacifism; their reluctance to start fights is vastly exceeded by their willingness to finish them. A unique part of their anatomy is a so-called 'accessory brain' that allows them to store memories for longer and with greater vividness than other species. Through prolonged physical contact with others (in particular, their offspring), the Cyeans can directly pass on skills they have learned throughout their lives.

The mid-21st century was a tumultuous time for the subcontinent. Fertilizer shortages, climate collapse, and a limited nuclear exchange with a pre-caliphate Pakistan led to sweeping crop failures. The ensuing famines resulted in the population of the most populous country on Earth falling from a peak of almost two and a half billion to a little over one billion. Combined with the political turmoil instigated by resurgent Hindu nationalist movements leading pogroms against India's Muslim and Buddhist minorities, it is nothing short of a miracle that India has not only persevered, but has become the center of innovation regarding novel agricultural techniques. Nevertheless, the farms and pastures of India are still strained both by the demand of the recovering Indian population and a deteriorating climate. The price of food in India is triple that of other nations on Earth. Many hope that the discovery of the New Worlds will be the key to securing not just Indian, but Terran food security for generations. Familiarity with farming in harsh conditions allows the Indian Colonies to start with an Expert Farmer.

Beset by North Korean terrorism and the growing power of nearby China, Japanese society became increasingly xenophobic and repressive, with the Emperor's [ITALIC]Sonno Joi[\ITALIC] Decree of 2030 entirely closing Japan off from the outside world for the first time since Commodore Perry's 1859 expedition. Since then, little is known about life on the heavily fortified islands. The few foreigners allowed in for business reasons report glimpses of astonishingly high technology and a roboticized culture that has become increasingly dysfunctional and bizarre. The birth rate has plunged to near zero, and much of the population is made up of androids. With absolute obedience to the omniscient Emperor masking a grinding stagnation and decay, the Chrysanthemum Throne has authorized an expedition to the New Worlds in a desperate bid for revitalization and growth. The Japanese colonies have difficulty attracting emigrants, but find it easier to purchase cloned or synthetic specialists from the homeworld, and can eventually fabricate some citizen types directly. With the potential to construct advanced robotic facilities that can operate unstaffed, each colony begins with a free Machine Shop.

Initially, Poland prospered after its liberation from Soviet occupation and accession to the European Union. This prosperity was not to last, however, as history has shown time and time again that the people of Poland can never enjoy good times for long. Poland was the nation that put up the strongest resistance to the expanding, authoritarian EU federal government; consequently, millions of European citizens fled their home nations for Poland in pursuit of the freedoms that had slowly eroded over the decades. This increase in population resulted in Poland becoming the most populous country in the EU, with an economy surpassing even that of Germany by 2039. Seeing the writing on the wall, the people of Poland decided to leave the European Union in order to preserve the liberties that were under threat from Brussels. Tragedy would follow as a then-young staff officer in the Polish military orchestrated a coup d'etat, betraying everything the Poles had spent the previous half a century fighting for. The self-styled Sovereignty of Poland boasted of the superficial freedoms retained by its populace, while repressing all meaningful forms of self-expression. Fortifying against a Nanny-State EU in the west and an expansionist Russia in the east, Poland has become increasingly militaristic alongside its libertarian platitudes.

With growing corruption undermining the rule of law on a global scale, virtually all of Earth's nations are permeated to varying extents by the vast and shadowy criminal organization known as the Syndicate. Syndicate crimelords now exert de facto control over several major metropolitan areas, diverting massive profits from organized crime into the formation of private armies and growing operations in offworld smuggling. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Operating almost entirely in the informal Black Market economy, the Syndicate's bands of offworld smugglers have difficulty selling large volumes of goods into the markets of Earth, but are adept in tax evasion and hiding illicit profits from their grasping superiors. All Syndicate colonies begin with a working Narcotics Lab.

By the time early humans and the early natives of the New Worlds were developing agriculture, the Progenitors were already incomprehensibly ancient. Though long absent from the New Worlds, the domain of the Progenitors extends across a vast swath of the observable universe, and very likely far beyond. The few fragmented records retained by the natives of the New Worlds suggest that the Progenitors were exploring the universe long before any mention of the wormholes appeared in their records. A plethora of the most prodigious minds of our timeline baselessly speculate that the Progenitors themselves are therefore responsible for the appearance of the wormholes. Much of the Progenitor technology that survives to the modern day seems to defy many known laws of physics; indeed, many scholars have lost their minds merely attempting to decipher how it functions and had to be sanitized as a result. While little about the biology of the Progenitors is known for certain, the prevalence of Progenitor artifacts in the freezing polar regions of the New Worlds suggests a preference for temperatures far colder than those favored by humans or the alien natives of the New Worlds. How the Progenitors will react to the arrival of humans in the New Worlds and the slow uncovering of Progenitor secrets by the inhabitants of the New Worlds remains unknown.

In the chaos surrounding the near-collapse of the petrochemical industry, much of the Islamic world has fallen under the sway of the Restored Caliphate, ruled by an extensive cabal of reactionary Muslim clerics. Encompassing vast areas from North Africa and the Middle East to fragments of the Indonesian archipelago, the largely Shi'ite theocracy clings to power with the aid of a brutally repressive inquisition, embroiled in a constant struggle to maintain control over restive Sunni and nationalist movements in its diverse population.

Initially a figurehead controlled by METI bureaucrats, the intelligence occupying the Chrysanthemum Throne eventually fused with various hypercompetent ministerial AIs, transcending its programming to become the sentient, omnipresent, digital Everemperor. Under its rule, imperial authority, government bureaucracy, and Japan's great corporate institutions have gradually merged into a single, highly centralized order.[NEWLINE]This unfathomable degree of technological advancement stands in stark contrast to a severe return to historical traditionalism and absolute, digitized rule. Yet Japan did not willingly choose its present isolation; terrified by the nation's unpredictable and accelerating technological evolution, foreign powers imposed a strict [ITALIC]Sakoku[\ITALIC]-style quarantine upon the islands. Contemporary Japan is now treated as a hazardous zone of technological hyper-evolution, contained behind a permanent military cordon, subjected to constant observation, and surrounded by severe restrictions on cross-border movement.[NEWLINE]Because the nation's networks are monitored by a sentient God-AI, traditional electronic warfare and hacking are entirely futile; gathering intelligence on contemporary Japan requires foreign agencies to deploy the same dangerous reconnaissance strategies used when exploring the hostile, uncharted sectors of the New Worlds. Consequently, little is known of life within this cordoned reality. What cannot be hidden, however, is the collapse of Japan's organic birth rate to near zero and the resulting state-mandated transition from a biological society to a synthetic one. Combined with strict foreign controls on Japanese migration, this accelerating transformation has made the country increasingly alien even to the rest of humanity.

Syndicate crimelords now exert de facto control over several major metropolitan areas, diverting massive profits from organized crime into the formation of private armies.

Through a series of exquisitely timed speculations in petrochemical futures, Indonesian real estate, and illegal loans, this ingenious businesswoman has rapidly amassed a fortune of incalculable size. The male-dominated Caliphate ecclesiarchy has grown increasingly dependent on her wide-ranging business interests, yet silently enraged that a shameless usurer (and worse, a female!) can exert such power. As everyone knows, the Sayyadina has legendarily expensive tastes which Earth is increasingly hard-pressed to satisfy - perhaps including a taste for unlimited wealth and power at the head of her own offworld empire.

A prominent scion of one of the many puppet Arab royal families used by the Caliphate government to keep its restless Sunni majority in check, this Cambridge-educated engineer has amassed a small fortune from canny investments skirting the bylaws of Islamic banking. Fearful of his growing support among certain Sunni nationalist elements, the Council of Ayatollahs has quietly forced him to head a seemingly doomed offworld expedition. Will His Highness remain a complacent pet of the Earthbound theocracy, or attempt to found a new royal dynasty amidst the indigo forests of the New Worlds?

The Restored Caliphate dominating much of the Muslim world is governed by a complex hierarchy of mainly Shi'ite Islamic jurists, who maintain a tenuous hold over their diverse population through a combination of apocalyptic preachings and a brutally repressive secret police, the Committee for the Promotion of Virtue and the Prevention of Vice. Ayatollah (from the Arabic ayatul-Lah, or "Sign of God") is a high-ranking title given to select Shi‘a clerics. Those who carry the title are considered experts in Islamic studies such as jurisprudence, ethics, and philosophy, and hold considerable power in the Caliphate theocracy. Only a few of the most important ayatollahs are accorded the rank of Grand Ayatollah.

A bitter rival of his younger protege, Director Green, this ruthless executive is renowned for his fiery temper and single-minded pursuit of personal wealth. In spite of his generous tranche of stock options, some among the Consortium's upper management have begun to question whether his interests truly align with their own.

Catapulted to upper-level management of the Consortium Space Systems subsidiary following a Machiavellian series of financial maneuverings, this consummate deal-maker masks his burning ambition behind a cool and businesslike veneer.

The highest levels of Consortium upper management are notoriously secretive. Insulated from criticism by their incalculable wealth and power, many Consortium executives are becoming increasingly detached from the harsh realities of the modern world, periodically issuing naive and eccentric directives that have begun to shake many of the Consortium's once unassailable monopolies.

The last remaining direct descendant of the Progenitor-era Cyean scholarly leadership, Nightinggale leads her people both politically and intellectually. Seeing the potential danger the newcomers to the New Worlds might pose, she endeavored to unite her fragmented people. Traveling from village to village, she flawlessly recited a song of her own composition, detailing the entire collected history of the Cyean people and ending with a plea for unity. Moved by her passion and her phenomenal voice, an impromptu council of elders and other prominent village leaders unanimously elected her to lead a now-united Cyean species. Her diplomatic and academic credentials will prove to be valuable assets to the Cyeans with the arrival of Humans in the New Worlds.
Although absent for millennia, the Progenitors are held in fear and awe by the natives of the New Worlds, and periodically issue threats and demands from their invisible realm beyond the wormhole.

Tens of millions of Buddhists fled the expanding empire of the People's Republic of China and the anti-religious policies of the Second Cultural Revolution. Many of these refugees found themselves in the cradle of their religion; unfortunately, they did not find a warm welcome. The Hindu nationalists in the Indian government, occasionally staying their hand against Indian Muslims (lest they have to answer to the Caliphate), exhibited no such restraint in dealings with the growing Buddhist minority. The Ascetic Cenobite, one of the first refugees to escape to India, became not just a prominent community leader in the Buddhist struggle for acceptance, but also a harsh critic of the government's total abandonment of anti-caste discrimination law enforcement. Chosen by the ISRO council to be the civilian governor of the expedition to the New Worlds in the hopes that his coreligionists will follow him, will The Ascetic Cenobite be the puppet the Indian government desires? Or will he lead those who walk the Noble Eightfold Path on a journey through the stars?

After declaring a state of emergency in 2046 following the first of many crop failures and poor harvests, the Rashtrapati (the President of India, a title translating literally to 'Lord of the Nation') has wielded a degree of executive power that can only be described as totalitarian. The erosion of civil liberties that was well underway by the 2030s was finalized when the office of Prime Minister was indefinitely suspended and parliament reduced to a handful of lawyers tasked with writing legislation at the Rashtrapati's direction. With a single-minded determination to maximize crop yields, the Rashtrapati has neglected all other aspects of society. Will she tighten her grip on the new alien breadbasket of humanity? Or will Navbharat slip through her fingers?

Believed to be the latest in a line of cyborg prototypes engineered from cutting-edge neurotronics grafted with genetic material from the descendants of the Imperial house, this enigmatic operative rules the Japanese colonies with cold efficiency and a surprisingly deep intuition. It is rumored that he was nearly terminated due to his unprecedented capacity for independent thought, but the continued stagnation of the Empire forced an exodus to the New Worlds in a desperate bid for change. Now free from the confines of the tightly cloistered Japanese islands, perhaps his makers can predict him least of all.

After Emperor Naruhito was assassinated by a North Korean operative in 2027 without leaving a male heir, his brain was placed in cryogenic suspension and, after a chaotic succession crisis eventually culminating in the Heisei Restoration, was posthumously encoded onto an early artificial intelligence matrix. Although initially a figurehead controlled by METI bureaucrats, this intelligence eventually fused with the various hypercompetent ministerial AIs, and now appears to permeate virtually all aspects of Japanese society.

Formerly the Minister of Military Procurement, the Libertarian Minister has been considered a subversive element since the nascent days of the Sovereignty of Poland. Beginning his career as an advocate of resistance to the overbearing EU federal government, he found himself merely redirecting his antipathy from Brussels to Warsaw. Unable to dispose of the Libertarian Minister without breaking the masquerade of freedom of speech, the Grand Chief of Staff appointed him to a series of superfluous ministerial positions in an attempt to force him to fade into obscurity. This plan was a complete failure even before the discovery of the New Worlds, as the Libertarian Minister grew both in prominence and military skill. Now exiled across the stars, will the Minister of Liberty finally fall into obscurity, or will he finally return to the Polish people the freedom denied to them for centuries?

Having grown to two hundred million souls strong, the ascendant Polish economy was nevertheless struggling with the number of migrants from the rest of Europe seeking the true freedom espoused by the union but only truly implemented from Warsaw. The man who would eventually adopt the moniker 'Grand Chief of State' rose to power during his takeover of the Third Polish Republic, re-establishing it as the Sovereignty of Poland. Launching simultaneous decapitation strikes on both the President and Parliament, the Grand Chief of State framed Brussels and coerced the remaining legislators into invoking Article 50 of the Treaty on the European Union - the first and only time this was done (a similar event was narrowly avoided in the United Kingdom as a result of the 2016 Kensington Incident). Consolidating power, the Grand Chief of State began a brutal crackdown on dissent while encouraging allegedly 'free' expression (mostly consisting of new ways to use the words 'Gowno' and 'Kurwa'), and Poland became a fortress. Every citizen of Poland has the 'right' to practice marksmanship and other militarily useful skills at the expense of the state (though, notably, they do not have the right to abstain from this). With the Polish mission to the New Worlds, will Poland's Grand Chief of State continue his iron-fisted reign over the Polish people across the universe, or will the facade of liberty give way to the true Polish dream?

The feared criminal mastermind known only as the Lady in Black stands at the head of a wide-ranging organized crime network composing multiple Mafia families and international cartels. After bitter infighting between rival Syndicate organizations erupted into a vicious gang war spanning several continents, the Lady accepted an eventual ceasefire giving up control of her Earth criminal empire in exchange for a total monopoly over offworld illegal activity.

All alien civilizations start with this policy. It provides aliens with new strategies and gameplay options normally inaccessible for Earthling colonists.
